notes: CREATIVE_BATCH_7.md CB7-X, code-freeze check 2026-10-30. DRAFT, promote second. Labelled 'worn pairs, new prints, L1 at most'. Never opens cross_venue_live/. Exits 0 'not testable' if GX failed. Depends on q0148 only for run order (the census census.json must sit at creative_batch7/census.json with the spec's sha256). Must finish and be committed before T7_X_list - 48 h. No network. Run order q0148, q0150, q0149. not_before is null in this draft: the CB7 freeze commit sets it to model_specs/cb7_v1.json dates.screen_not_before_utc when the draft is promoted (the screen also refuses before that time by itself). Operator: run scripts/oracle/union_jsonl.py on the host before the screen and pass --union-recorded-utc <time> in argv, otherwise the cumulative count in the result is labelled 'pre-union lower bound' (feeds only the BY triage label). Crash recovery: if the job dies after results_<T>.json is written but before the trial lines, a re-run refuses (write-once) and the test stays uncounted; the operator then appends the four trial lines by hand from the results file (see CB7_ANALYSIS_CODE_NOTE section 6b), never rewriting the results.
